src: Adapt the old, accommodate the new to solve issue
hyp: Anpassen an das Alte, sich dem Neuen anpassen, um das Problem zu lösen.

src: At the precinct level, we just need to look at the Sydney CBD as an example of an area which has grown from its pre-settlement landscape into a two-storey city, from a maximum height of 150 feet to the soaring towers of today. At a much scaled-down level, the same can occur across Sydney's town centres located around transport nodes. Inner suburbs must also evolve, with a swing to more affordable apartment living at heights below the tree tops on key sites. Of course, the new growth in housing needs to be well-designed and trees, landscaping and parks need to be included along with other essential infrastructure.
hyp: Auf der Bezirksebene müssen wir uns nur das Beispiel des Sydney CBD ansehen, um zu sehen, wie ein Gebiet, das sich aus seiner vorkolonialen Landschaft entwickelt hat, in eine zweistöckige Stadt gewachsen ist, von einer maximalen Höhe von 150 Fuß bis hin zu den heutigen schwebenden Türmen. Auf einem viel reduzierten Niveau kann dasselbe in den Stadtzentren von Sydney um die Verkehrsknotenpunkte passieren. Die Innenstadtviertel müssen sich auch weiterentwickeln, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf preiswerterem Wohnraum in Form von Apartments in Höhen unterhalb der Baumwipfeln auf wichtigen Standorten. Natürlich muss die neue Wohnbebauung gut geplant sein und Bäume, Grünanlagen und Parks müssen zusammen mit anderen unverzichtbaren Infrastrukturen enthalten sein.

src: Our planning system also needs to adapt so that planners in suburban councils, who seem to be less supportive of change, are not the only determinants of the future shape of their suburbs. A way forward could be to have an independent decision-making body that championed quality design as long as it fitted below the tree tops and incorporated family living, large balconies, common gardens and presented a friendly appearance. This could be a role for the current NSW government architect working within a carefully crafted complying code.
hyp: Unsere Planungssysteme müssen sich auch anpassen, damit Planer in städtischen Ratsversammlungen, die es scheint, weniger unterstützen die Veränderung, nicht die einzigen Determinanten der zukünftigen Form ihrer Vororte sind. Eine Möglichkeit könnte sein, ein unabhängiges Entscheidungsgremium zu haben, das Qualität des Designs als lange Zeit, solange es unter den Baumkronen passte, und Familienleben, große Balkone, gemeinsame Gärten und eine freundliche Erscheinung beinhaltete. Dies könnte eine Rolle für den derzeitigen NSW-Government-Architekten sein, der innerhalb eines sorgfältig gestalteten einvernehmlichen Codes arbeitet.

src: Over the past decade, our lives have changed through technology, with many working from home, and Sydney has gained an impressive network of metro and light rail systems. Our ability to purchase online has changed the way we shop, and friends and family seem closer because of smartphone communication. All of these adaptations from one system to another can also occur in our built environment through a planning focus on adaptive reuse rather than preferencing heritage preservation.

Unsere Fähigkeit, online zu kaufen, hat den Weg, wie wir einkaufen, geändert, und Freunde und Familie scheinen sich wegen der Smartphone-Kommunikation näher zu sein. Alle diese Anpassungen von einem System zum anderen können auch in unserer bebauten Umwelt durch einen Planungsschwerpunkt auf adaptive Wiederverwendung statt auf die Vorzugsbewahrung von Erbe stattfinden.

src: A final push for female equality
hyp: Ein letzter Schub für die Gleichberechtigung der Frauen

src: Last year, the World Economic Forum forecast that it would take five generations to achieve gender equality in every nation. Now the World Bank wants to rapidly accelerate that time frame.

src: The international financial institution is poised to launch a strategy aimed at significantly advancing the rights and economic opportunities for girls and women by 2030. The plan focuses on improving inclusivity and resilience through access to finance, technological innovation, and changes in public policy and law.
hyp: Die internationale Finanzinstitution bereitet sich darauf vor, eine Strategie zu lancieren, die darauf abzielt, bis 2030 die Rechte und wirtschaftlichen Chancen von Mädchen und Frauen erheblich zu verbessern. src: "Recent research demonstrates that both social norms and mindsets can change, for example, that engaging men and boys can foster their support and buy-in for gender equality," a consultative draft of the plan states. src: Shifts in thought are harder to quantify than bank loans for rural women or school enrollment for girls. Yet there is plenty of evidence that female agency can move mountains. In Iran, for example, women have led the greatest threat to the Islamic government in 40 years simply by refusing to comply with laws that force them to cover their hair. In some of the 130 countries with minimum quotas for female representation in government, such as India, male resistance to female voting and political activism has eased.

Doch es gibt genügend Beweise dafür, dass weibliche Agentur Berge verschieben kann. In Iran haben Frauen zum Beispiel die größte Bedrohung für die islamische Regierung in den letzten 40 Jahren nur dadurch ausgelöst, dass sie sich weigerten, Gesetzen zu folgen, die sie dazu zwingen, ihr Haar zu bedecken. In einigen der 130 Länder mit Mindestquoten für die weibliche Vertretung in der Regierung, wie zum Beispiel in Indien, hat sich der männliche Widerstand gegen das weibliche Wahlrecht und die politische Aktivität gelockert.

src: In some rural African communities, civil society organizations are replacing a harmful rite of passage with health education. src: The World Bank cites other examples. From 1970 to 2022, Bangladesh quadrupled female literacy rates and doubled female participation in the labor force. src: German farmers and train drivers are scaring Germany's bosses

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

Diese Mistgabelmobs (Pitchfork-Mob), wie manche es nun nennen, wird Deutschlands harmonische Arbeitsbeziehungen im kommenden Jahr auf die Probe stellen.

src: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. These measures pushed farmers over the edge. It also mobilised other angry workers, already straining under the pressure of inflation, recession and the government's self-imposed austerity. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.
hyp: Die Proteste wurden angeblich durch die Entscheidung des Regierung, die Subventionen für Dieselkraftstoff im Agrarsektor abzuschaffen und eine Ausnahme von der Kfz-Steuer für landwirtschaftliche Fahrzeuge zu streichen, ausgelöst. Diese Maßnahmen trieben die Bauern über den Rand. Es mobilisierte auch andere wütende Arbeiter, die bereits unter dem Druck der Inflation, der Rezession und der von der Regierung selbst auferlegten Sparmaßnahmen zu knapp waren. Am 9. Januar begannen die Fahrer von Güter- und Personenwagen der Deutschen Bahn, der nationalen Eisenbahn, einen Streik wegen Arbeitszeit und Lohn.

src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.

Die Landwirten wiesen die Zugeständnisse als unzureichend zurück. Am 4. Die Automobil-, Chemie- und Stahlindustrie, Deutschlands größte Branchen, sind besonders auf den Güterverkehr angewiesen.

src: The workers" mood is increasingly angry. "Appeals are circulating with fantasies of revolution," warned Mr Habeck. The far-right Alternative for Germany party is doing its best to fan the grievances. src: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Local bosses are already fretting about a German version of the gilets jaunes protests in France in 2018, which culminated in yellow-jacketed demonstrators torching cars on the Champs-Elysées and the police stepping in with tear gas. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. This year is shaping up to be even tougher.

src: As the EU debates rules to limit packaging waste, beer producers argue they are being unfairly discriminated against with exemptions for winemakers from reuse targets and deposit-return schemes, but one of Europe's wine industry association chiefs says brewers should "mind their own business."

src: Environment ministers agreed an EU Council negotiating mandate on the proposed Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) before Christmas, paving the way for imminent political talks with the European Parliament, which are already underway at the technical level.

src: "Our position is clear," the trade association Brewers of Europe wrote to MEPs and government negotiators (10 January). "If targets and mandatory requirements in the PPWR apply to beer then there is a legal obligation that they apply to all alcoholic beverage categories."

src: The 18 December ministerial summit yielded a carve out for winemakers from the requirement that, by the end of the decade, 10% of products must be supplied in reusable containers within a system for reuse or refill, rising to 40% in 2040. src: The Washington jail system is experiencing a fatality crisis. Although we come from a variety of backgrounds, including jail administration, civil rights advocacy, and experience being incarcerated in jail, we all agree that there must be independent oversight of Washington's jails.

src: More than 130,000 people were booked into a Washington jail in 2022, and yet there is startlingly little information about what occurs once they get there. src: What we found demonstrates that immediate action is required. Even accounting for Washington's population growth, the Washington jail death rate nearly tripled between 2000 and 2019 - an increase 16 times that of the national average. Outpacing other states, Washington now has the fourth-highest rate of jail deaths in the nation. This cannot continue.

Washington liegt jetzt an vierter Stelle der Länder mit der höchsten Sterblichkeitsrate in Gefängnissen. Dies kann nicht weitergehen.

src: Reversing the trend of jail deaths, and solving the many other issues facing our jails, may require some difficult policy decisions. By our count, at least 25 states have a statewide office responsible for overseeing jails, and all of them have a lower rate of jail deaths than Washington.

src: For most travelers, the aircraft model isn't a deciding factor when booking a flight. src: The airplane model is typically noted in the booking information for a flight. src: Determining which aircraft models are the safest is less straightforward. The National Transportation Safety Board maintains comprehensive databases of information about accidents and incidents. src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. But those models had accumulated fewer than 1 million departures at the time of the report.

src: Running a business as a self-employed introverted creative and having a big heart for privacy shouldn't feel like a twist, but sometimes it is. The majority of online resources and coaches tell you to work with big (and evil) tech using extrovert techniques. Advertise here, follow the algorithm, share your personality. Get a blue tick on that service, be available 24/7, answer inquiries with a video of yourself, respond immediately. Video, video, video.
hyp: ビジネスを自営で行い、内向的で創造的でプライバシーを大切にする心を持つことは、奇妙なことのように感じるべきではない。しかし、時々それはそう感じる。オンラインリソースやコーチの多くは、外向的で悪いテクノロジーを使うことを勧めています。ここで広告を出して、アルゴリズムに従って、自分の性格を共有してください。サービスで青いチェックマークを取得し、24時間いつでも利用可能で、ビデオで質問に答え、即座に返信してください。ビデオ、ビデオ、ビデオ。

src: I don't want to feed Big Tech with money, data and my energy. Or coaches who have their one extroverted solution that they apply to everyone. I'm exploring new ways of doing business, while fighting my long-held belief that you have to do things a certain way to be successful.
hyp: 私は大手テクノロジー企業に金銭、データ、エネルギーを与えたいのではなく、コーチが全員に適用する独自の外向きの解決策を持つ人も嫌だ。私は、成功するには特定の方法で物事を行う必要があるという長年の信念を戦いながら、ビジネスを新しい方法で行うことを探している。

src: In Germany, where workers and bosses run many companies jointly, a big strike is unusual. A wave of big strikes is almost unheard of. Right now the country of "co-determination" is simultaneously facing an eight-day "action week" by irate farmers, who blocked roads with tractors, a three-day strike of railway workers and, to top it off, a looming strike of doctors, who already closed surgeries between Christmas and New Year's Day. This Mistgabelmop (pitchfork mob), as some have taken to calling it, will test Germany's harmonious labour relations in the year to come.

src: The protests were ostensibly set off by the government's decision to end subsidies for diesel fuel used in agriculture and to cut an exemption from car tax for farm vehicles. On January 9th drivers of freight and passenger trains at Deutsche Bahn, the national railway, began a strike over working hours and pay.

src: In an effort to defuse the tension with the farmers, the government agreed to a gradual removal of the diesel subsidy over three years and to keeping the exemption from the car tax. The farmers pooh-poohed the concessions as insufficient. On January 4th an aggressive group of them prevented Robert Habeck, the economy minister, from disembarking from a ferry on his return from a family holiday. If the train drivers are similarly unimpressed, that could prove expensive for German business, reckons IW Köln, a think-tank. The rail strike could cost businesses €100m ($110m) a day if it forced them to interrupt production. The car, chemical and steel industries, Germany's biggest, are especially reliant on rail transport.

Ikiwa vifurushi vya treni pia vinaonekana kama kosa, hii inaweza kuwa na madhara kwa biashara ya Ujerumani, kwa kuzingatia IW Köln, kituo cha uchunguzi. src: Thomas Puls of IW Köln fears that the strikes will harm the image of Germany as a place for business. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany's police union, warned in an interview with Tagesspiegel, a daily, that the farmers were probably "just the start of an enormous wave of protest this year." Germany was the only big economy to shrink in 2023, and the year ended on an especially sour note, with an unexpected drop in business confidence in December. src: Reversing the trend of jail deaths, and solving the many other issues facing our jails, may require some difficult policy decisions. src: Another useful resource the FAA links to is the Boeing Worldwide Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents 1959-2022, which assesses plane-type safety by breaking down accidents based on the aircraft model. src: About 450 million years ago, plants took a giant leap out of the oceans onto the land to become the plants that we know and love today. But how did they survive? Scientists at the John Innes Centre may have found out. Land plants survive by getting water and nutrients from the soil. They do this by forming a special friendship with soil-dwelling fungi called mycorrhiza. These strands of mycorrhiza reach deep into the soil and drag the nutrients and water back to the plants. But when the first algae landed on soil, how did they survive long enough to form these beneficial friendships?

src: The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier is a monument dedicated to servicemen who gave everything in defense of our country. The soldiers of the 3rd United States Infantry Regiment, the Old Guard, took over the right to guard the Tomb in April of 1948, and continue to carry on this sacred duty. The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier has been guarded 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 365 days a year, for the past 77 years.

src: JANUARY 14th, 10:26 PM, 2543.

src: The cold, rainy night ensued my long overdue walk–exploring the city of Paltricus was a privilege to those who’d been safe from the mutation via escape, or pure luck. The city night was beautiful, illuminated with vibrant stars that remained for thousands of years. It must be lonely in the great distant sky. Paltricus was a nice place, but it felt more like a cage than a luxurious place of living. Filled to the brim with apartments, homes, and any other building able to hold occupants, most buildings were hundreds of stories tall; thanks to Ignniat. The mineral that appeased technology, and architecture was a great mineral that extended our foundation of life. Public knowledge only knows so much about this mineral though, mainly because mainly because it’s kept under pretty tough wraps.

Iliwa kwa kiasi kikubwa na makazi, nyumba, na nyumba yoyote inayoweza kuchukua watu, nyumba nyingi zilikuwa na majengo mengi; kwa sababu ya Ignniat. Dawa ya asili iliyopunguza teknolojia, na ujenzi ulikuwa dawa nzuri iliyotengeneza msingi wetu wa maisha.
